design_description: A navy jersey with a refined royal-inspired colour palette, combining deep blue with gold, red and orange detailing. The front is defined by a central vertical stripe composition, with a broad red stripe framed by thin gold/orange lines running from the collar to the hem. Matching accent stripes run along the shoulders and side panels, while the handwritten-style APACOL FC wordmark gives the centre a more elegant, distinctive character. The back is deliberately cleaner, keeping the navy base with gold name and number, while red/gold details appear at the collar, cuffs and sides. Overall, it's a classic, premium-looking design with strong vertical symmetry and subtle Spanish-inspired colours.
